verdict.rationale: Greptile automatically reviews every PR and produces a review summary, which carries a Fix All button. It also generates sequence diagrams and flowcharts for every PR to help parse complex changes, plus a 0-5 merge-safety score readable at a glance. These support fast reviewer orientation, but the docs never describe a prose summary of what changed or a file-by-file change walkthrough. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the summary's content (a description of the changes, not just issues), a per-file change walkthrough, independent hands-on corroboration of summaries or diagrams.
